symptom: R2E Run #11 rejected a successful HKEX cross-check because the workflow asserted status == PASS while the accepted R2D adapter emits PASS_REFERENCE_CONSISTENT.
root_cause: A downstream workflow duplicated an upstream component's status literal instead of binding to the upstream canonical contract/status semantics.
permanent_control: R2E now asserts the exact canonical R2D status PASS_REFERENCE_CONSISTENT plus publication_allowed=true and primary_authority_unchanged=true.
regression_rule: Downstream workflows must consume canonical upstream status semantics; do not invent or retain stale shorthand literals after an upstream contract evolves.
